title: Field Guide: Numbers, Prices & Practical Math

words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这瓶水两块钱。(Zhè píng shuǐ liǎng kuài qián.) — This bottle of water is two yuan.
一共五块五毛钱。(Yígòng wǔ kuài wǔ máo qián.) — In total five yuan and fifty cents.
一元等于十角。(Yì yuán děngyú shí jiǎo.) — One yuan equals ten jiao.
两样东西一共多少钱？(Liǎng yàng dōngxi yígòng duōshao qián?) — How much are these two items in total?
这里支持微信支付吗？(Zhèlǐ zhīchí wēixìn zhīfù ma?) — Do you accept WeChat Pay here?
我可以用支付宝付钱吗？(Wǒ kěyǐ yòng zhīfùbǎo fù qián ma?) — Can I pay with Alipay?
请稍等，我找钱给你。(Qǐng shāoděng, wǒ zhǎoqián gěi nǐ.) — Please wait a moment, I will give you your change.
请留一下您的电话号码。(Qǐng liú yíxià nín de diànhuà hàomǎ.) — Please leave your phone number.
不好意思，我没有零钱。(Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ méiyǒu língqián.) — Sorry, I don't have small change.
全场衣服今天打八折。(Quánchǎng yīfu jīntiān dǎ bā zhé.) — All clothes are 20% off today.
这件衬衫售价一百零八块。(Zhè jiàn chènshān shòujià yì bǎi líng bā kuài.) — This shirt sells for 108 yuan.
这台电脑售价两千块。(Zhè tái diànnǎo shòujià liǎng qiān kuài.) — This computer costs two thousand yuan.
这个月预算是一万块。(Zhè ge yuè yùsuàn shì yí wàn kuài.) — This month's budget is 10,000 yuan.
两块零五分。(Liǎng kuài líng wǔ fēn.) — Two yuan and five cents.
第二件饮品半价。(Dì èr jiàn yǐnpǐn bànjià.) — Second drink is half price.
请问这个停车场怎么收费？(Qǐngwèn zhè ge tíngchēchǎng zěnme shōufèi?) — How does this parking lot charge?
店里的茶水是免费的。(Diàn lǐ de cháshuǐ shì miǎnfèi de.) — The tea in the store is free of charge.
今天咖啡买一送一！(Jīntiān kāfēi mǎi yī sòng yī!) — Coffee is buy-one-get-one-free today!
这个合理的价格吸引了很多人。(Zhè ge hélǐ de jiàgé xīyǐn le hěn duō rén.) — This reasonable price attracted many people.
新鲜草莓今天特价只要十块钱。(Xīnxiān cǎoméi jīntiān tèjià zhǐ yào shí kuài qián.) — Fresh strawberries are on sale for just 10 yuan today.
我把餐费转账给你了。(Wǒ bǎ cānfèi zhuǎnzhàng gěi nǐ le.) — I transferred the meal cost to you.
请用计算器算一下总数。(Qǐng yòng jìsuànqì suàn yíxià zǒngshù.) — Please calculate the total with a calculator.
这是您的小票，请拿好。(Zhè shì nín de xiǎopiào, qǐng ná hǎo.) — Here is your receipt, please hold onto it.
